# ATS repository instructions

Before substantive work, read `AI_HANDOFF.md` and `AGENTS.md`.

Use `00_Управление_проектом/v2/PROGRAM_STATE_V2.yaml` for the current program state during M0 rebaseline and `02_СЛЕДУЮЩИЙ_ШАГ.md` for the next required action.

Do not treat the legacy G01–G13 documents as the current program roadmap.
